title: TrollMod
description: This mod adds chaos to your Minecraft!
body:
# TrollMod: The Ultimate Prank Mod

TrollMod is the perfect tool to drive your friends crazy on a server (or suffer yourself). It's not just a difficulty tweak; it's a psychological horror disguised as 2017 memes, modern slang, and pure chaos. 

### ⚠️ IMPORTANT WARNING (AI GENERATED)
> **This mod was 100% written by an AI** (with the guidance of a human who survived the development hell of legacy Forge 1.12.2). There might be bugs, weird timings, or unpredictable consequences. This mod was created purely for fun and pranks. Use at your own risk!

---

### 🩸 How to activate the Chaos?
The mod doesn't start working immediately. It waits for the perfect moment.
1. Join a world and wait for exactly **30 seconds**.
2. A very fast zombie with the green nametag `<Trololololololo>` will spawn near you. It will say "Hello" in the chat and start attacking you.
3. As soon as this zombie dies (killed by you, fall damage, or lava) — a red message will appear in the chat: **`TROLOLOLOLOLOLOLO MODE: ACTIVATED`**.
4. There is no going back.

---

### 😈 What awaits you (Features):

* 🔄 **Inverted Controls:** Every 15-20 seconds, your movement keys (WASD) will be mirrored. You'll try to run away from a creeper, but run straight into it instead.
* 💰 **Deadly "MrBeast Says" Game:** Every couple of minutes, a task will pop up on your screen (e.g., "Jump" or "Sneak"). 
  * If it starts with *"MrBeast Says:"* — you have exactly 3 seconds to do it.
  * If it starts WITHOUT this phrase — **do nothing**. 
  * If you fail? You take damage and get mocked in the chat (e.g., *"You just trusted to MrBreast"*).
* 💎 **Fake Diamonds:** Fake diamond ores will generate in the caves. They occasionally flash with a redstone texture. If you break one, you get a block of dirt and take **5 hearts of damage**.
* 💻 **Chat Scam Links:** The bot periodically spams about viruses on your PC. If you accidentally (or intentionally) click the `totally-not-sus.mc` link in the chat, the game will silently and instantly **cut your current health in half**.
* 🖼️ **Screen Memes & Jumpscares:** Giant "PROBLEM?" or "LE FUUUU" texts covering half of your screen, and Mr. Incredible randomly sliding in from the left side with a loud sound effect right while you're trying to survive.

---

**Version:** Minecraft 1.12.2 (Forge)  
**Perfect for:** Pranking friends, streaming, hardcore survival challenges, and testing your mental stability. 

*P.S. If you find a bug... it's probably a feature.*
